title: Saved by Grace and United in Christ
summary_text: Paul describes people as dead in trespasses and sins, following the desires of the flesh and facing God's wrath. In His mercy and love, God made believers alive with Christ and saved them by grace through faith, apart from works, for a life of good works. Gentiles once lacked hope and a share in the covenants of promise, but Christ's blood has brought them near. Through His death, Christ abolished the law of commandments and reconciled both groups to God, making peace between them. They now belong with the saints in God's household and grow together into a holy temple where God lives by His Spirit.
